title: MZ Message window inside the conditional branch disappears before the choice list

posts.author: Jobhob
posts.body: Does anyone know plugin or workaround for messages inside the conditional brances before the choice list? The message disappears in this case, which is annoying, because the only way to make it stay is to leave it as is before the choice list. I searched, and it seems there are no plugins or solutions to that, which I hardly believe. If anyone knows how to solve this, please let me know.

posts.author: Another Fen
Solar_Flare
posts.body:
Another Fen said:
you cannot put special text commands in variables, so you would have to splice around those if your text contains some
Click to expand...
…what are you talking about? Why would you be unable to put special text commands in variables?
EDIT: I gave it a try and figured out why you'd think that. It's because of the backslash substitution. You can still use them, but there's a bit of extra syntax:
Code:
◆Control Variables：#0001 = "This is a test of \x1bN[1].\x1b..\x1b.."
◆Text：None, None, Window, Bottom
：    ：\V[1]
All those
1b
are there to make the text codes work.
EDIT2: That plugin looks great, but it won't directly solve the original poster's problem, since they have multiple If statements to skip over. Perhaps it could work out with a bit of enhancement to the plugin if the statements are rephrased as an if-else chain though? On the other hand, I have a feeling that their specific problem is better solved with a plural substitution plugin…

posts.author: Krimer
posts.body:
Oh yeah, I forgot about _indent.
Add this line right after this.jumpTo(i + 1):
JavaScript:
this._indent = this.currentCommand().indent;
Or just copy the code from my previous post I updated it there.
Should fix it

posts.author: Jobhob
posts.body: Yup, it fully works now, both in test and actual project. Thanks for help!
